body: At Andrew C. Marine, Attorney at Law, every client is worked with individually. Bankruptcy is stressful, overwhelming and at times frustrating, which is why it matters to have someone at your side every step of the way.
Attorney Marine will help determine which form of bankruptcy is best for your situation and build a custom solution for your debt, from the initial petition to negotiating with the trustee.
list: A personal relationship with every client

items.q: Am I eligible to file for bankruptcy?
items.a: For Chapter 7, your household income generally needs to be below the median for a household of the same size, or you must pass the “means test.” The formulas get complicated, so it’s worth talking it through.

items.q: What are the alternatives to bankruptcy?
items.a: You can try to negotiate with creditors to extend due dates, lower interest or forgive part of the debt. Many people find creditors unwilling to agree to reasonable terms.

items.q: Can bankruptcy help with student loans or taxes?
items.a: In some cases they can be included in a Chapter 13 repayment plan and paid off over time, which can save money. In rare cases they may be dischargeable.

items.q: Will I lose everything in Chapter 7?
items.a: Usually not. Most people considering Chapter 7 own property that state law protects, so most of their debt can be discharged without losing it.
No, this is general information. Every situation is different: call (803) 649-0875 to talk through yours.
